estudio.subtitle: Creative studio of the VRYP group. AI-driven audiovisual production and our own digital casting.

manifesto.label: Manifesto
manifesto.p1: We were born so the idea wouldn't have to wait for production. When a brief calls for a two-week campaign, there's no room for three weeks of physical casting, two of pre-pro and five days of post.
manifesto.p2: We work with a proprietary roster of digital talents with consistent identity across pieces, rights cleared by contract and immediate availability. Each talent in the catalog was born to live in advertising: declared archetype, commercial tone and assigned market.
manifesto.p3: Yutro is the studio. Casting and Production are two lines of the same team. One point of contact, one invoice, one creative guarantee.
